designs.claim: At matched single-view augmentation marginals and prespecified class-risk equivalence, independent pre/post augmentation increases the loss of a fixed historical-intervention-target decoder relative to shared augmentation.
designs.causal_scope: Effect of randomized augmentation policy assignment on that fixed decoder's loss; not the effect of the historical world intervention and not Bayes-information identification.
requirements: Nondegenerate classY and intervention variation withinY
Verified pre/post unit metadata and independent unit-level evaluation
Oracle class stability established before augmentation assignment
Fixed decoders with interpretable source-side positive control
Predeclared equivalence margin and main paired loss
falsification_or_failure: No prespecified directional or practically relevant decoder loss gap
Target decoder has no positive-control ability
View marginals or unit independence fail
The original historical intervention metadata is actually incorrect
designs.negative_control_scope: Providing augmentation parameters, restoring inputs or relabeling targets in a new coordinate system changes information, policy or task. Gap removal under these controls does not automatically refute the original fixed-decoder estimand.
designs.novelty_decision: Rejected as an original candidate: known information-retention/structured-pair principle; using intervention-target decoding alone is not established incremental novelty.
designs.one_day_condition: Potentially a small CPU frozen-decoder replication if lawful matched data and decoder already exist; current public-data execution prerequisites are incomplete. No measured runtime claim.

designs.claim: When an image transform is verified to correspond to a known node permutation and componentwise invertible latent map, propagating target indices, values, units and mechanisms should remove purely representational inconsistency in the oracle intervention-distribution description, not necessarily a fixed neural decoder's loss.
designs.estimand: Oracle intervention/measurement consistency defect under the specified known mapping, not a correlation or a new physical causal effect
requirements: Valid mapping of the allowed intervention family
Calibrated measurement units and fixed original world query
falsification_or_failure: Corrected intervention semantics still disagree under an allegedly exact mapping
Transform leaves the original rendering manifold
General axis mixing is incorrectly assumed to preserve single-node interventions
Uncalibrated postprocessing measurements are interpreted as the original world outcome
designs.novelty_decision: Rejected as an original candidate; retained as an implementation/semantics negative control only.
designs.one_day_condition: An oracle synthetic unit check needs no neural network and is small in principle; no new generator or experiment was run in this audit.

world_effect_not_identified_by_target_de: tau_j(v1,v0)=E[W_(t+h)^(do(Z_j(t)=v1))-W_(t+h)^(do(Z_j(t)=v0))] requires a defined horizon, units, treatment values/assignment regime and sufficient identification design or known mechanisms.
